title: Gold standard process Markovian poisoning: a semiparametric approach
summary: We consider in this paper a stochastic process that mixes in time, according to a nonobserved stationary Markov selection process, two separate sources of randomness: i) a stationary process which distribution is accessible (gold standard); ii) a pure i.i.d. sequence which distribution is unknown (poisoning process).
